title: Frost Lines
reference: repeat 4 { F2 } def F1 { repeat 3 { forward } activate } def F2 { F1 F1 turn_right }
hints: Thin ice all the way around, a switch every three tiles. You only get one lap, so don't waste a step.
F1 walks three tiles and flips a switch. F2 does that twice and turns the corner. Main repeats F2.
repeat 4 { F2 } def F1 { repeat 3 { forward } activate } def F2 { F1 F1 turn_right }
